about_the_game:
SweetDreams is a new, first person, 3D adult indie game series based on perfect dream scenarios. Each episode will feature a different dream scenario, with a different dream girl.

This is Season 1 Episode 1: Electra.

In this episode, you've just moved into your new apartment. There's no bills and no stress. Just when you think it couldn't get any better, you realise your new housemate is a gamer girl named Electra, and she's in her bedroom waiting for you to introduce yourself.

The game is rich in atmosphere, coziness, and sexual intimacy. You can go through the short story mode at your own pace as you develop things with Electra, or even opt for a more relaxing and borderline-ASMR experience if you prefer: gaze into the calming fishtank in the living room next to the glow of the salt-lamp, out of the windows into the mesmerising endless rolling clouds, or even hang out in Electra's room on her beanbag chair while she's doing her thing. 

NaughtyMode

Once you've completed the story mode, you unlock NaughtyMode. NaughtyMode drops you straight into more sensual action with Electra, giving you a more customisable experience, and is accessable at any time, for however long you like. 

Panic Button

Pressing the in-game panic button (P key) instantly hides your screen and replaces it with a normal-looking space desktop image, faking a desktop background and muting the games audio. This is useful if you need to quickly hide the game. Press P again to go back.
